memories.content: Mara's mother Adaeze's afib is controlled for now after a Lagos cardiologist adjusted her meds (as of 2026-05-10), and Chidi sent a video of Adaeze cooking and bossing him around the kitchen.

entities.name: Adaeze
entities.description: Mara's mother, has atrial fibrillation, lives in Lagos

entities.name: Chidi
entities.description: Mara's younger brother, with their mother in Lagos

memories.content: On 2026-05-10 Mara decided not to fly to Lagos right now, reasoning her mother is stable, Chidi is there, and showing up in a panic would only scare her; she'll go when it's a visit, not an emergency.
Mara found it freeing to actively decide rather than dread, framing her choice not to fly home as a clear-eyed call rather than a guilt-driven one (2026-05-10).
Mara does pottery and is excited that her teacher Wen is soon teaching glazing (as of 2026-05-10).
